d:
Aaj ki rat tujhe aakhiri khat aur likh dun
Kaun jane yah diya subah tak jale na jale?
Bam barud ke is daur men malum nahin
Aisi rangin hava phir kabhi chale na chale.
Zindgi sirf hai khurak taink topon ki
Aur insan hai ek kartus goli ka
Sabhyata ghumti lashon ki ik numaish hai
Aur hai rang naya khun naee holi ka.
